verdict.rationale: Installing an operating system on existing hardware is a fair question for an OS, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers migrating files from a PC to a new Mac via Migration Assistant and running Windows on a Mac, which is the opposite direction. Nothing documents installing macOS in place of another OS on the user's current machine, and a passing community mention of a Hackintosh is an unsupported user-side workaround that earns no credit.
